and Coimbatore on 21 November. ( AI-generated image used for representational purpose ) AI Quick Read Gold, silver prices today, 21 November: Gold prices crashed about 9% this week after five days of decline and its largest weekly loss since March 2026, as per a Bloomberg report. Bullion lost close to 9% this week, trading near $3,500 — close to its lowest level since September 2025 and Silver slipped 15%, it added. Meanwhile, spot gold fell 3% to $3,514.08 per ounce on Friday, US gold futures for December delivery settled 4.6% lower at $3,515.40 per ounce, and spot silver fell 4.1% to $40.99 per ounce, 66.3% below its record high of $121.64 hit in January, Reuters reported. All precious metals are poised for their second consecutive weekly declines, it added. This came amid a market-wide crash due to investor pullout and anxiety over artificial intelligence companies, the continued war between the US and Iran, and indications of further interest rate hikes by the hawkish United States Federal Reserve, as per the Bloomberg report. Gold, silver rates today: 18K, 22K, 24K gold and 999 Fine silver prices across Indian cities At the time of writing on 21 November, gold bullion was trading at ₹ 1,22,510 per 10 grams, while Silver was at ₹ 1,49,590 per kg, data on the bullion website showed. The 24-karat gold price in Mumbai was ₹ 1,22,290 per 10 grams. Meanwhile, the price of 22-karat gold in Mumbai was ₹ 1,12,099 per 10 grams. On the other hand, the 18-karat gold rate in Mumbai was ₹ 91,718 per 10 grams. The silver price in Mumbai today, 21 November, was in line with the overall silver rates in India. The price of Silver 999 Fine in Mumbai was ₹ 1,49,320 per kg.
